title: ChatFilter
description: A lightweight and customizable chat filter plugin for Paper servers that blocks prohibited words, filters commands, and helps keep chat clean.
body:
# VanillaChatFilter

A lightweight and powerful chat filtering plugin for Paper servers.

VanillaChatFilter helps server owners keep chat clean by automatically blocking prohibited words and phrases. The plugin can filter public chat, private messages, and selected commands while notifying staff members about violations.

## Features

* Real-time chat filtering
* Custom blocked words and phrases
* Private message filtering
* Command filtering support
* Staff notifications
* Console logging
* Permission-based bypass system
* Easy configuration
* Tab completion support
* Folia compatible
* Paper 1.21+ support

## Commands

### Admin Commands

`/cf add <word>`

* Adds a word to the filter

`/cf remove <word>`

* Removes a word from the filter

`/cf list`

* Shows all filtered words

`/cf test <message>`

* Tests a message against the filter

`/cf reload`

* Reloads the configuration

Aliases:

* `/chatfilter`
* `/filter`

## Permissions

`vchatfilter.admin`

* Access to all management commands

`vchatfilter.bypass`

* Bypass chat filtering

`vchatfilter.notify`

* Receive staff alerts when filtered messages are detected

## Why Use VanillaChatFilter?

VanillaChatFilter is designed to be lightweight, efficient, and easy to configure. Whether you're running a small SMP, a PvP server, or a large network, the plugin provides a simple way to maintain a clean and friendly chat environment without impacting server performance.

## Supported Platforms

* Paper
* Folia
* Minecraft 1.21+

Keep your community safe and your chat clean with VanillaChatFilter. 🛡️
